mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson_progress (enrollment_id, lesson_id, course_id, student_id, is_completed, time_spent_minutes) VALUES (#{enrollmentId}, #{lessonId}, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{isCompleted}, #{timeSpentMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lesson_progress WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}
mapper.update: UPDATE lesson_progress SET is_completed = TRUE, completed_date = NOW() WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_progress WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND is_completed = TRUE
